notes: Polish pass: pets follow at a comfy distance (no more clipping into you), drift around you when you stand still, follow you through tunnels, have their own voices and idle life, love being petted, and can be named (/pets name). NPCs turn to look at you, greet you and talk in speech bubbles, sometimes about you, the time or the weather. Rare ores, yew/magic logs, gems, big fish and herb harvests feel better.
